column1: # The Structured Append cases, the input half of verified/structuredappend.tsv.
# Unlike every other fixture the payloads are not the texts in texts/: a sequence needs kilobytes.
# A case therefore states its text as a generator, a length and a seed, resolved by RandomText.
# A length of "search" makes the export find the longest text that still fits into the 16 QR codes
# of a sequence and emit it together with the next length up, which does not — one input row, two
# rows of the fixture. Such a row expands in place, so keep them last unless you mean to renumber
# The same text with and without an announced ECI, which every code of the sequence pays for out of
# its capacity. Both are pinned rather than only the announced one, since the port's automatic
# Every error correction level on one text and version.
# Version ranges: the whole range, a wide upper range, and a narrow one.
# Small versions, where the headers are a large share of a code.
# Long payloads: many codes, and a single code that only just avoids being two.
# The 16-code ceiling, pinned from both sides.
